summary: Inspect a local repository and guide cost-aware security logging recommendations from collected evidence.
limitations: The scanner reports local repository signals; an analyst or agent must review them before making recommendations.
CVE reachability report checks validate structure and evidence integrity only; semantic reachability and agent behavior require separate repository-specific review.
No host installation is proven by the repository checks.

demo.description: Scan the plugin package itself and emit repository context as JSON.
